title: Am I Understanding this Sub Correctly?
content: So my mall world is actually a dystopian residential structure. Mostly it's vertical with a giant elevator, and a huge skylight. Lots of metal structures. There is no fresh air coming in from the outside. It's just a place where you remain, almost in a nursing home capacity. What used to be shopping stores are converted into living quarters, but the clear glass window in front of each store is still there, so passersby can basically watch you in your home like some kind of pet if they wanted to. You never leave the mall. Am I the only one?
